# testing_x_unknown_values (Resource)

XUnknownValues Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_x_unknown_values" "my_xunknownvalues" {
  closed_enum_string                 = "off"
  optional_computed_open_enum_int64  = 1
  optional_computed_open_enum_string = "small"
  optional_open_enum_string          = "red"
  required_open_enum_string          = "gamma"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `required_open_enum_string` (String) possible known values include one of ["alpha", "beta", "gamma"]; Requires replacement if changed.

### Optional

- `closed_enum_string` (String) Closed enum string (x-speakeasy-unknown-values: disallow). Should retain OneOf validation and reject unknown values. must be one of ["on", "off"]; Requires replacement if changed.
- `optional_computed_open_enum_int64` (Number) possible known values include one of [1, 2, 3]; Requires replacement if changed.
- `optional_computed_open_enum_string` (String) possible known values include one of ["small", "medium", "large"]; Requires replacement if changed.
- `optional_open_enum_string` (String) possible known values include one of ["red", "green", "blue"]; Requires replacement if changed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `response_only_open_enum_int64` (Number)
- `response_only_open_enum_string` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_x_unknown_values.my_testing_x_unknown_values
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_x_unknown_values.my_testing_x_unknown_values "..."
```
